annotation.bound_parties_text: Law enforcement agencies, state agencies, and governing bodies (e.g., city councils and county boards of supervisors) overseeing law enforcement agencies are bound.
annotation.bound_parties_quote: A law enforcement agency shall obtain approval of the governing body, by an ordinance adopting a military equipment use policy
annotation.dates_quote: No later than May 1, 2022, a law enforcement agency seeking to continue the use of any military equipment that was acquired prior to January 1, 2022, shall commence a governing body approval process
annotation.robot_provision_quote: “Military equipment” means the following: (1) Unmanned, remotely piloted, powered aerial or ground vehicles.
